caseName: Teleprompter Corp. v. Columbia Broadcasting System, Inc.
caseNameFull: Teleprompter Corp. v. Columbia Broadcasting System, Inc. and Columbia Broadcasting System, Inc. v. Teleprompter Corp.

opinions.text: C. A. 2d Cir. Motion of National Cable Television Assn., Inc., for leave *818to file a brief as amicus curiae in No. 72-1628 granted. Certiorari granted. Cases consolidated and a total of one hour allotted for oral argument. Reported below: 476 F. 2d 338.
